name: FAQ · boxed
description: Six common questions in expandable panels.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: Yes. Every paid plan starts with a 14-day free trial, and no credit card is required.

items.question: Can I change plans later?
items.answer: Of course. Upgrade, downgrade or cancel at any time from your account settings. Changes are prorated.

items.question: Do you offer discounts for non-profits?
items.answer: Registered non-profits and schools get 50% off any plan. Contact us with proof of status to apply.

items.question: Can I use my own domain?
items.answer: Yes. Connect any domain you own in a few clicks, and we will provision SSL for you automatically.

items.question: Where is my data stored?
items.answer: Data is stored in ISO 27001-certified data centres in the EU and US, with daily encrypted backups.

items.question: How do I get help?
items.answer: Our support team is available 24/7 via chat and email, and Business customers get a dedicated manager.
